name: System
definition: Set of integrated applications that provides centralised services such as clearing, netting, reconciliation, trading and/or settlement.

SystemDateTime.name: System Date Time
SystemDateTime.definition: Date time of a system performing a task.

SystemLanguage.name: System Language
SystemLanguage.definition: Specifies the language used by the system.

Location.name: Location
Location.definition: Location, address and country in which the system is located.

Reconciliation.name: Reconciliation
Reconciliation.definition: Reconciliation process provided by the system.

Availability.name: Availability
Availability.definition: Information about the activity or non-activity of the system.

Event.name: Event
Event.definition: Specific point in time associated with the system's processing cycle. Operations of a system are composed of a series of processes, the closing, or completion, of which constitutes an event with an associated time stamp. An event may have a series of time stamps associated with it, such as the scheduled and effective completion times.

PartyRole.name: Party Role
PartyRole.definition: Specifies each role linked to a system.

SystemGeneratedInformation.name: System Generated Information
SystemGeneratedInformation.definition: Business details provided for an information system.

VersionValidityPeriod.name: Version Validity Period
VersionValidityPeriod.definition: Date at, or period of time during which, the stipulated version is in effect.

Negotiation.name: Negotiation
Negotiation.definition: Negotiation process which uses a ssystem.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Account managed by a system and held by a system member.

TradesPosition.name: Trades Position
TradesPosition.definition: Specifies the status of trades and their value inside a system.
